scope: runtime patch of the two receive gates

setup.client: canonical exe (SHA 55F067AC...), started with a fresh session name
setup.handshake: reached phase 8 with the EOF=5 server (enterworld12)
setup.verify: both writes confirmed by reading back the process memory

result.client: dropped to state 0 shortly after the patch; ring_b read only 38 packets
result.events: the last milestones include 'Com Error' (0x4F82E0) after menu/view exceptions
result.interpretation: forcing the parse past the two receive checks makes the client parse garbage and hit Com_Error. So the checks are not the defect: they correctly reject an invalid/short message. The real question is why 0x674EB0 (receive) or 0x674740 (length) fails after the gamestate.

conclusion: gate patch proves the checks are healthy; the client genuinely has no valid packet to parse after the gamestate, which matches the earlier ring-B observation. The next target is the ring-B consumer / the receive helper 0x674EB0 rather than the parser.
